## 1. Professional Background
Muhammad Farhan is an Indonesian Fullstack Web Developer and Software Engineer currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Informatics Engineering (Teknik Informatika) at Universitas Muhammadiyah Riau with a GPA of 3.91 / 4.0. He is a recipient of the prestigious Riau Provincial Government Scholarship (Beasiswa Pemerintah Provinsi Riau).

Prior to university, he graduated from SMKN 2 Pekanbaru majoring in Software Engineering (Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak) with a score of 90/100, where he was awarded the "Siswa Teknologi 2023" accolade.

He has over 4 years of hands-on experience in software development, starting as a Web Developer Intern at PT Netviro (2022-2023) and subsequently operating as an independent fullstack consultant and founder of HanDigital.

## 2. Technical Stack & Architectures
- **Frontend Core**: Next.js 14/15/16 (App Router, Server Components, Route Handlers), React 19, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES2024), Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, GSAP.
- **Backend & APIs**: PHP 8.2/8.3, Laravel 10/11/12, Livewire 3, Inertia.js, Node.js, Express.js, RESTful API architecture, Webhook consumers.
- **Data Persistence**: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Firebase Firestore, Cloudinary Media CDN.
- **Integrations & Payments**: Midtrans Snap/Core API (QRIS, BCA/Mandiri/BRI Virtual Accounts, GoPay, ShopeePay), OAuth2, SMTP/Resend, Telegram Bot API, WhatsApp Business integration.
- **Architecture & Practices**: Clean Architecture, Repository Pattern, MVC, Atomic Design UI, Git branching workflows, Strict Anti-Slop UI standards.

## 4. Notable Projects & Case Studies
- **Escaluc OS**: Enterprise ERP and omnichannel Point-of-Sale (POS) designed for retail gadget chains. Features multi-outlet stock sync, serial/IMEI tracking, cashier barcode workflows, and automated profit/loss calculation. Stack: Laravel, Vue.js, Inertia.js, Tailwind CSS, Electron.
- **KKNFlow**: Digital management system for university community service programs (Kuliah Kerja Nyata). Facilitates work program scheduling, daily log verification, and PDF executive summary generation. Stack: Laravel, Inertia.js, Tailwind CSS, Midtrans, MySQL.
- **BankID API**: Lightweight, blazing-fast API service aggregating bank routing codes, clearing codes, and validation algorithms for major Indonesian banks. Stack: Node.js, Express.js.
- **Portal BKA UMRI**: Academic and financial affairs portal for Universitas Muhammadiyah Riau incorporating NVIDIA NIM AI inference for automated student request categorization. Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Inertia.js, Laravel, MySQL.
- **Catetin**: AI-assisted note-taking and smart task prioritization app. Stack: Flutter, Dart, Firebase, GetX.
- **Sala Coffee**: Cloud-based POS, QR digital table ordering, and kitchen display system integrated with Midtrans for automated payment settlement. Stack: Laravel 12, Livewire 3, Tailwind CSS, Midtrans.
- **SIAM Redesign**: Next-generation academic portal concept with ultra-responsive UX and micro-interactions. Stack: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion.
- **LangkahHijau**: Environmental gamification platform encouraging youth ecological participation. Stack: Laravel 12, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS 4.
